name: FrankenGirl
source:
After an attack leaves you dying, you're revived by a mad scientist who has made you into a Frankenstein monster. In order to regain your body, you must defeat monsters and collect their body parts and cores, while balancing school, friendships, and romance. 

Oh! And you have 30 days to do it or you'll turn into a monster. 

[From [url=https://starlit-carnival-studios.itch.io/frankengirl]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一次攻击导致你死亡后，一位疯狂的科学家将你变成了弗兰肯斯坦怪物，使你复活。为了恢复你的身体，你必须击败怪物并收集他们的身体部位和核心，同时平衡学校、友谊和浪漫。

哦！你有30天的时间去做，否则你就会变成怪物。

[来自[url=https://starlit-carnival-studios.itch.io/frankengirl]itch.io[/url]]
